messages:
Marie L.: Morning team — I uploaded the Optimize launch post draft. Need quickpass on: hero quote, one benchmark sentence, CTA wording, and preferred publish time. Doc: https://go/redwood/optimize-launch-draft :wave:

Devin: On it. Will check hero + bench in ~30m. Prefer 10am PT for publish (good traffic).

Jess: Small copy nit: current bench reads 'reduces tokens by 40%'. Can we change to 'reduces effective token cost by ~40%' to be precise?

Marie L.: Good catch, make that edit. Also need a short CTO quote — Samir can you confirm or tweak the suggestion below?

Samir: Tossing a compact option:
```
"Optimize lets teams cut inference cost without sacrificing latency — making serving decisions practical at scale."
```
Open to tightening.

Devin: I like it. Shorten for hero card maybe:
```
"Optimize helps teams cut inference cost while keeping latency production-ready."
```
:+1: reads cleaner.

Jess: Approved bench wording update. For CTA propose: "Try Optimize free — get tailored batching suggestions and cost estimates." Thoughts?

Marie L.: CTA good. Growth asked for HubSpot UTMs to capture webinar signups: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_medium=post`

Samir: UTMs fine. Legal, any concerns with quote or bench? @LegalBot can you quickpass?

LegalBot: Quickpass done — no red flags. Recommend swapping 'production-ready' -> 'production-grade' to avoid absolutes.

Samir: Updated quote to:
```
"Optimize helps teams cut inference cost while keeping latency production-grade."
```
All set from my side.

Devin: Editorial note: hero should be <120 chars for social card. Samir quote is ~86 chars, good. Bench sentence short too.

Marie L.: Plan: publish 10am PT tomorrow unless anyone objects. @PublishBot please schedule and include UTMs + CTA link to webinar signup.

PublishBot: Scheduled for 2026-03-22T10:00:00-07:00. Assets attached: hero quote, bench snippet, CTA with UTMs. Reminder: run smoke check at T-30m. :robot_face:

Jess: I'll do the T-30m smoke copy pass and verify embeds/snippets.

Devin: I'll prepare social assets and the benchmark thread.

Marie L.: Thanks all — quickpass closed. If anything changes ping this thread. :sparkles:
